title: Correct height H
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be H = 60 m.

title: Correct voltage U
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be U = 1000√2 V or its numerical equivalent.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the horizontal displacement equation L = v₀cosθ * t.

title: Energy conversion relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must equate the projectile's kinetic energy (½mv₀²) to the converted capacitor energy (η * ½CU²).

title: Time of flight calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must solve for the time of flight t from the horizontal motion equation.

title: Vertical displacement calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the height H using the vertical motion equation H = v₀sinθ * t - ½gt².

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should correctly handle unit conversions, especially for microfarads (μF) in the capacitance.

title: Sign error in vertical motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the vertical displacement equation uses +½gt² (incorrect sign for gravity) instead of -½gt².

title: Efficiency misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the efficiency η is applied incorrectly (e.g., ηE_k = E_capacitor instead of E_k = ηE_capacitor).
